game_title: Fallback: Sum Sprint – Hollow Log Trail
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the forest ranger must hold off giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Sum Sprint: Accumulate a total across a loop to pay a toll at Hollow Log Trail.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Accumulate a total across a loop to pay a toll at Hollow Log Trail. Then check total and advance.
player_objective: Protect the vine bridge from giant beetles in Hollow Log Trail: keep total above zero until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Sum Sprint
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 5, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
